entryPoints.name: check
entryPoints.command: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm docs:check && pnpm test && pnpm build

entryPoints.name: docs:check
entryPoints.command: node scripts/check-markdown-code.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p docs/snippets/tsconfig.json && pnpm docs:outputs --check

entryPoints.name: release:publish
entryPoints.command: pnpm build && pnpm pack:check && changeset publish

entryPoints.name: release:canary
entryPoints.command: changeset version --snapshot next && pnpm install --lockfile-only && pnpm build && pnpm pack:check && changeset publish --tag next --no-git-tag

entryPoints.name: typecheck
entryPoints.command: node lab/bin/checkjs.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.alchemy.json && turbo run typecheck

entryPoints.name: build
entryPoints.command: tsdown && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --rootDir src --outDir dist && node experiments/copy-assets.mjs

entryPoints.name: stress-test:smoke
entryPoints.command: STRESS_BACKEND=sqlite STRESS_EMPLOYEE_COUNT=10000 STRESS_UPDATE_ROUNDS=0 STRESS_ASSERT_PERFORMANCE=false vitest run
